caption: The drawing shows a single glass pitcher placed centrally on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or decorative elements. The pitcher is rendered in shades of blue and purple, with a semi-translucent appearance that reveals subtle internal reflections and refractions consistent with glass material. The body of the pitcher is bulbous at the base and gradually narrows upward, forming a long neck that supports a stopper with a faceted design. Vertical ridges run along the body of the pitcher, adding texture and dimension. The handle is a deep blue, smoothly curving from the neck down to the upper body of the pitcher, and appears solid and attached at two points. There is a small spout at the top, adjacent to the handle. The drawing includes the signature "Geo. J. File" in small text near the lower right corner.
title: Blue Glass Cruet and Stopper
